The horizontal position of the pointer in the graphics buffer, from 0 on the left to `GraphicsWidth() - 1`. When the window is scaled, the position is converted back to buffer pixels. [MoveMouse](MoveMouse) sets it. BlitzPlus programs can also pass a canvas handle to get the position relative to that canvas.

```blitzbasic
;media still mouse/mousex.png
Graphics 320, 240, 0, 2
SetBuffer BackBuffer()
MoveMouse 200, 90
Cls
Color 255, 255, 255
Line MouseX(), 0, MouseX(), 239
Line 0, MouseY(), 319, MouseY()
Text 10, 10, "MouseX = " + MouseX()
Text 10, 24, "MouseY = " + MouseY()
Flip
WaitKey
```

![MouseX](media/mouse/mousex.png)
@param canvas  BlitzPlus only: a canvas handle, to get the horizontal position relative to that canvas. Defaults to 0, which is the graphics buffer.
@param device  Only look at this mouse, counted from 0 as in MouseDeviceCount. -1 (the default) means all mice together. With a device, the position is that of a pointer that only this mouse moves; it starts in the middle of the buffer and stays inside it.
@returns The horizontal position of the pointer.
@gap The Device argument is a BlitzLLVM extension: the original has no such argument and only knows one mouse.
